item.title: Melo Pearls: Reading Flame Patterns
item.description:
GEMOLOGY FACT: Melo pearls can show flame-like surface patterns. These patterns may appear patchy or pointed.
EXIMUTC view: Surface beauty and identification answer different questions. Request laboratory documentation rather than judging natural origin from orange colour alone.
Source: www.gia.edu https://www.gia.edu/gems-gemology/summer-2021-labnotes-melo-pearl-found-in-a-melo-shell
